faq.question: How do I install this mod?
faq.answer: Download the latest release from the sidebar and place the contents of the zip file into your game's `BepInEx/plugins` folder.

faq.question: Is this compatible with multiplayer?
faq.answer: Yes! This mod is designed to work seamlessly in multiplayer sessions. However, **all players** must have the mod installed to avoid sync issues.

faq.question: Can I include this in my modpack?
faq.answer: Absolutely. We encourage modpack creators to include our work. A credit link back to this OpenMods page is appreciated but not required.

faq.question: I found a bug! Where can I report it?
faq.answer: Please use the **"Report a Bug"** button in the Links section to open an issue on our GitHub repository.

faq.question: Does this mod work on Linux or macOS?
faq.answer: Yes, as long as you are using the appropriate version of BepInEx for your platform, the mod should function correctly.
